scripts.script:
local Library = loadstring(Game:HttpGet("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bloodball/-back-ups-for-libs/main/wizard"))()

local PhantomForcesWindow = Library:NewWindow("Kuncicoco Hub")

local KillingCheats = PhantomForcesWindow:NewSection("Aimbot")

KillingCheats:CreateButton("Aimbot Gun", function()
game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer.Character:WaitForChild("pistol good gun "):WaitForChild("Model"):WaitForChild("casing"):FireServer()
end)

KillingCheats:CreateToggle("Auto Aimbot Gun", function(value)
if value then
  while true do
    wait()
  game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer.Character:WaitForChild("pistol good gun "):WaitForChild("Model"):WaitForChild("casing"):FireServer()
  end
  else
  return
 end
end)

_G.Good = "true"
